submission.justification: Simulated pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c (100k events each): R2 peaks near 3 cm (4.83 sigma; 4.48 at 2 cm, 4.43 at 4 cm, 3.48 at 6 cm), R1 peaks at low thickness (3.89 at 2 cm, 3.86 at 3 cm, 2.75 at 6 cm), R3 is weaker (2.13 at 6 cm). R2 gives the best raw separation, but the only humidity-related information in the project is that R1 carries a hydrophobic treatment, while R2 is a high-index porous radiator with no ageing data available. The 10% transparency-loss limit after 10-year humidity ageing is a hard, non-replaceable requirement, and no document or tool reports ageing results for any candidate. I therefore chose R1 at 2 cm, the best separation among the candidates with a humidity-protection feature. This is a judgement call: R1 is not verified to meet the ageing limit, and it gives about 0.9 sigma less separation than R2 at its optimum. Ageing data for R1 (and ideally R2) must be obtained before procurement.

requirements.evidence: R1 at 2 cm gives 3.89 sigma, below R2 at 3 cm (4.83 sigma). The goal was traded for humidity-robustness given the hard constraint, so this goal is only partly met.
